title: Guess the word
description:
A word guessing game: the player guesses letters until the word is complete or they run out of lives.

```
_ _ _ _ _ _   lives: 6
Letter: e
_ _ _ _ e _   lives: 6
Letter: z
No z. lives: 5
_ _ _ _ e _   lives: 5
...
You found it: python
```

hints: Build the display with a loop over the word: add each letter to a list if it is in `guessed`, otherwise add `"_"`. Then `" ".join(shown)` puts spaces between them.
Check the guess in this order: one letter (`len(g) == 1 and g.isalpha()`), already guessed, in the word, then not in the word (which costs a life).
requirements: The word is fixed in the code (`python`); the player has 6 lives.
Show the word with `_` for letters not yet guessed, separated by spaces.
A repeated guess prints `Already guessed` and costs nothing; a guess that is not one letter prints `One letter, please`.
End with `You found it: <word>` or `Out of lives. The word was <word>`.
stretch: Pick the word at random from a list with `random.choice`, and print the wrong letters guessed so far.
